description: This Java source file defines an exception class 'PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an error case when a function's signature does not conform to expected parameters, types, or structure, and provides builder and serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a pipeline function's signature is invalid. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PlaceholderException, providing static methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and builder pattern support.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for this exception with a default message based on the invoked parameters and pipeline function.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes this exception from a JsonObject, given associated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Provides a mutable builder initialized with the current exception's state.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated dittoHeaders, copying other properties from the current instance.
